`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than what you'd expect to sell in the 6 days a new order takes to arrive. The 6 is `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` near the top of the file, right under the imports.

Running it on your current `inventory.csv` gives:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend is flagged because 9 on hand is under the 14.4 it sells in 6 days, and oat milk because 30 is under 45. An empty shelf still shows `OUT` as before.

The flag appears only once stock is below 6 days of sales, so an item with exactly 6 days left still shows `ok`. There is no safety margin, so a busier-than-average week or a late delivery would still leave a gap. If you want earlier warning, raise `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` by a day or two.
